governingRule: Only Chat 1 registers numbered Drizzle migrations, edits src/db/schema/index.ts or centralized database/CI tooling.

candidates.feature: Canonical given/family names and optimistic identity-profile version
candidates.decision: Do not parse given/family names from display_name and do not update Identity Platform email with DB-only mutation

candidates.feature: Per-college public branding display and admin edit contract
candidates.decision: One row per college, preserve 10 branding fields, URL/object path and privacy policy need explicit validation
tests: branding fallback and archived college exclusion

candidates.feature: Persisted DNS TXT proof diagnosis bounded to 500 chars
candidates.decision: Untrusted TXT values require redaction/retention and restricted admin read; verified recheck cannot silently revoke proof
tests: verified recheck failure leaves verified true

candidates.feature: Per-device session listing and revoke-one parity without raw provider cookies
candidates.decision: Choose provider-only with proven device revoke equivalence OR provider cookie and scoped keyed-session digest; never create insecure duplicate auth authority
tests: persisted revoke/expire checked on each authorized request
legacy FACULTY privilege escalation must not be cloned

candidates.feature: Server-side OTP challenge budget, email fallback and bounded expiry with keyed MAC
candidates.decision: Prefer managed provider OTP only if exact login user jobs documented; raw 6-digit short OTP must not be stored
tests: email-only recruiter challenge never uses dummy SMS OTP

candidates.feature: Composite user membership and college key scope on challenge
candidates.decision: nullable membership requires CHECK college present; parent composite uniqueness must be registered first

candidates.feature: Single-use cross-host identity handoff, 2-minute TTL and host binding
candidates.decision: Never persist or return raw Firebase/legacy refresh/access tokens; bind high-entropy code MAC to current valid host/member
tests: change host, user status or membership rejects consume

candidates.feature: Composite owner/membership/college and verified domain/college constraints
candidates.decision: Domain and member college must match, and member user must match handoff user; FKs alone do not prove active/verified state
tests: verify current persisted actor+domain on consume

promotionChecklist: Chat 1 review active legacy source semantic contracts and approve redesign/retirements field by field.
Reject duplicate tables and choose a single optional platform session/OTP approach before table promotion.
Register parent composite keys before child FK constraints and generate one consistent Drizzle migration/snapshot; never run raw candidate SQL directly.
Check source declaration vs generated migration drift, empty and latest DB replay, exact SHA references.
Verify private storage/branding URL policy, hostname ownership and provider session/OTP acceptance independently.
Run all negative cross-tenant, FK, replay and concurrency tests on disposable Postgres and retain logs.
Record either accepted source parity or explicit justified intentional security exception for each live legacy behavior.
Only after all implementation and executed acceptance update DB-004 to COMPLETED then DONE_VERIFIED; no worker may advance the shared phase alone.
